run_xSIM: run the xSIM function to calculate multilingual similarity error rate between two embedding files
calculate_error: calculate the xSIM error between source and target sentence embeddings using k-nearest neighbor search
run_score_margin: run the score_margin function to compute ratio or distance margin scores for k nearest neighbors
review_Margin: review the Margin enum class with RATIO, DISTANCE, and ABSOLUTE margin types for xSIM scoring
run_get_transform: run the get_transform function to look up error type from augmented JSON for a closest neighbor
